International applicants should reference the following information in order to successfully submit an application to Michigan State University. Be sure to explore each tab of content.
While the content below is helpful for international applicants, additional and more comprehensive considerations can be found at the Office for International Students and Scholars website.
Application Tips
Tips that will help prospective international students successfully apply to MSU.
Learn More
English Language Competency
All international applicants and applicants whose first language is not English must be able to be proficient as a condition for regular admission to MSU.
Learn More
Guidance for Specific Countries
View guidelines and requirements that are unique to specific countries, regions, or educational systems.
Learn more
Required Documentation
View information about documentation that is required for admission to Michigan State University.
Learn More
Quick Tips
View information regarding application formatting, passport & visa information, degree equivalency, and more.
Learn More
